item.title: 【Cinema Center】SERIES - iCarly DVD iKiss (EXCLUSIVE DVD FROM BRAZIL) Episodes
item.description:
Here are the episodes taken from the iCarly O Primeiro Beijo (iKiss) DVD. This DVD was made exclusively for Latin America, not being a DVD of a specific season, but a compilation of episodes with romantic themes. It includes episodes from seasons 2, 3, and 4. The video files include the original audio, Brazilian Portuguese dubbing, and Spanish dubbing. Enjoy!
